model_role: Claude Sonnet 5 classified every candidate pair, independently of a deterministic algorithm
human_task: Two blinded reviewers adjudicated the pairs on which the two procedures disagreed, the pairs the model could not decide and the pairs between the algorithm thresholds
agreement: Audits: no false merge in 200 merged pairs; no duplicate in 1000 pairs not proposed for merging

human_task: Two reviewers, 200 random records each, blinded

model_role: No model (the safety net registered in the protocol was not used)
human_task: Two reviewers screened all 22,403 records independently and blinded in Rayyan; discrepancies resolved by consensus or a third reviewer

model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 read 5939 full texts and proposed a decision per criterion with verbatim evidence (INCLUDE 3037, EXCLUDE 2322, DOUBTFUL 580); 182 of them were later recorded as not retrieved (doubtful reports, extraction, verification, wrong or truncated PDF, re-reading), which leaves 5757 reports assessed
human_task: Stratified random sample of 20% of the decisions (822: 469 exclusions, 353 inclusions not contributing to a pooled estimate) re-read by reviewers blinded to the previous decision; the 65 disagreements arbitrated by a third reviewer
agreement: Blind reader versus model: observed agreement 92.1%, Cohen's kappa 0.84 (0.80–0.88); after arbitration 8 model decisions upheld and 57 changed (6.9%)
outcome: 41 of 469 sampled exclusions (8.7%) became inclusions (27 without susceptibility testing) and entered the distribution analysis; 15 of 353 sampled inclusions (4.2%) and 1 report that the model had left as doubtful and the reviewers had included became exclusions; 3 of the added reports contributed to a pooled stratum

stage: Data extraction: compartments and number of isolates
model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 extracted, for every included report, the compartments of recovery and the number of C. tropicalis isolates
human_task: The blind readers of the 20% sample recorded both fields independently, without seeing the model's extraction; compared in the 332 reports that the model and the blind reader both included
agreement: Same compartments in 328 of 332 (98.8%; 95% CI 96.9–99.5); same number of isolates in 317 of 330 (96.1%; 95% CI 93.4–97.7), within 10% in 322 (97.6%)
outcome: Discrepant values resolved at arbitration or in the row verification

model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 proposed a verdict with evidence for the 316 reports left as doubtful
human_task: The two registered reviewers decided every report independently; disagreements resolved by consensus
agreement: Reviewer 1 versus reviewer 2: 312 of 316 (98.7%) same category; model proposal versus final decision: 309 of 316 (97.8%) same verdict category
outcome: not retrieved 106; enters review 105; remains excluded 63; enters review and ma 42

stage: Reports excluded by the model during extraction
model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 excluded 500 reports during extraction; for 349 of them a second reading proposed a verdict, 151 were left for review without proposal
agreement: Second-reading proposal versus decision: 284 of 349 (81.4%) same category
outcome: admitted to the distribution analysis 336; remained excluded 118; recorded as not retrieved 45; admitted to the meta-analysis 1

model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 extracted every row from the full text with notes on ambiguities and calculations
human_task: Every row of every report eligible for the meta-analysis checked against the PDF (5098 rows of 1214 reports); 106 rows added by the reviewers were checked by a second reviewer
agreement: Model row versus PDF: 4213 confirmed (82.6%), 816 corrected (16.0%), 69 removed (1.4%); fields corrected: criterion 656, n_S 140, n_SDD_I 119, n_R 39, n_tested 30, n_NWT 19, compartment 11; added rows: 75 confirmed, 28 corrected, 3 discarded
outcome: 1182 reports eligible for the meta-analysis, 32 not eligible

stage: Collections, rows not estimating a prevalence, species identification, allocation and agronomic management
model_role: Model-generated proposals (candidate pairs of reports describing the same collection; rows suspected of not estimating a prevalence; species identification method; allocation of isolates and documentation of agronomic management in natural matrices)
human_task: Reviewers decided 384 candidate pairs, 136 flagged rows, 141 identification methods, 6 allocations and 5 natural-matrix reports
agreement: Pairs: proposal was definite (YES) for 15, PARTIAL for 269 and left for review for 100; identification: proposal confirmed in 100 of 141 (70.9%); flagged rows: 86 excluded and 50 kept
outcome: Pairs: same collection 129, partial overlap 90, different 165; allocation rows removed or reassigned 6

model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 answered specific questions from the reviewers and edited the wording of comments; it decided nothing
human_task: The 808 exclusions outside the blind sample that contained terms specific to susceptibility testing or could not be read as text were read jointly by two reviewers, to establish how many eligible reports had been excluded
agreement: Not applicable: joint reading, no agreement statistic
outcome: 737 confirmed; 57 included (8 eligible for the meta-analysis, 3 contributing to a pooled stratum); 14 recorded as not retrieved

stage: Data extraction: rows of the reports added in the last round
model_role: Claude Opus 5.5 proposed the rows of the 15 reports from the full text (8 of the re-reading and 7 of the arbitration of the blind sample)
human_task: Reviewers checked 53 rows of 15 reports against the PDF and decided the collections and the rows that do not estimate a prevalence

model_role: Two further independent runs of Claude Opus 5.5 with the same instructions on 200 full-text decisions and 50 extracted reports
human_task: None: this measures repeatability, not accuracy

outcome: Number of isolates and compartments reproduced in all 50 re-extracted reports; all counts in 167 of 201 and 171 of 209 rows common to the runs
